plan.goal: Size the PLINK binary .bed storage for a GWAS genotype dataset of 19056 samples and 2895710 variants (411988 on the largest chromosome), reporting total .bed size, per-chromosome .bed size, and number of per-chromosome files.
plan.rationale: PLINK binary .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant (4 samples/byte). Total .bed size = n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB. Per-chromosome .bed size uses the largest chromosome's variant count (411988, consistent with human chr1). Number of per-chromosome files = number of chromosomes in the split; for a standard human GWAS this is 24 (22 autosomes + X + Y), or 23 if the Y chromosome is excluded. The user must confirm the chromosome set in the lab.
caveats: Confirm whether the dataset includes the Y chromosome (and/or mitochondrial DNA) — this changes the per-chromosome file count by ±1 (24 vs 23).
The per-chromosome .bed size reported is for the largest chromosome (chr1); smaller chromosomes have proportionally smaller .bed files.
These sizes cover the binary .bed only; the accompanying .bim and .fam files add a small additional footprint, and any .bed→.bgen or VCF conversion will be substantially larger.
